title_zh: 更正人体模型的心肺标签和血流图说明

scenario.goal_zh: 为生物课展示核实模型部位及图片标签。

context_zh: 学生为生物课整理人体模型和配套示意图。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Ruby
sentences.text: I've put the heart label on this organ, but the shape looks wrong.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: That's one of the lungs. The heart sits between the lungs, slightly to the left.

sentences.speaker: Ruby
sentences.text: Then the label on this diagram is wrong too. It says the heart makes oxygen.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: It pumps blood. The lungs take oxygen from the air into the blood.

sentences.speaker: Ruby
sentences.text: I'll swap the model labels and change the diagram to show the heart pumping blood.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Let's check the finished labels against the textbook illustration.

sentences.speaker: Ruby
sentences.text: They match now. I'll put the model and diagram together on the display table.
